### Added

- **Send later.** Long-press or right-click Send, press Ctrl+Shift+Enter, or pick Send later in the attach menu to schedule a message. Presets or a date and time. Scheduled messages show as a chip in the chat and in a per-chat and a global list, where you can send now, edit the time or text, or delete them. Android can use exact alarms if you allow them and still sends on an inexact one. In the browser they are sent only while Velta is open.
- **WebSocket transport** on Android and Windows. Mail can go through a WebSocket proxy, the same kind the browser app uses, via a local SOCKS5 listener. Proxies are saved and switchable. A `velta://ws` link or QR adds one after a confirmation.
- **Proxy invite links.** Proxy operators can hand out signed invite links with an expiry, a device limit (`invite NAME --uses N`), and revocation.
- **Invite cards in chat** for chat, group, relay and proxy links, and **relay invite signup** straight from Add account.
- **DNS tunnel**: a deep link and QR share (link v2, shared by default), Windows support, and several saved tunnels with one or none active.
- **One-command deploy scripts** for a DNS tunnel server and a standalone WebSocket proxy (`tools/deploy-dns-tunnel.sh`, `tools/deploy-ws-proxy.sh`, docs/deploy-*.md).
- An **Archived (n)** row at the bottom of the chat list when you have archived chats.

### Changed

- **Faster.** Incoming messages are batched per frame, notification and chat-list work is coalesced, message-row gestures use one delegated listener, scrolling is cheaper, and the QR scanner, large-file upload and image compression load on demand. On a busy account the longest UI freeze dropped from about 600 ms to under 50 ms, and opening a chat from about 140 ms to 114 ms.
- **Smaller QR codes.** Every QR the app shows uses optimal numeric/alphanumeric/byte segments.
- **Icons** come from one shared set, with a redrawn outline QR icon and SVG marks in place of text glyphs.
- The drawer's local-chat switch is **Velta Loop**, subtitled "Local chat on the same network".
- About no longer shows the "No phone number needed…" note.
- French and Russian translations cover the new screens.

### Fixed

- **Android background delivery and battery.** No permanent wake lock; a reconnect nudge every 10 minutes, skipped while push delivers; the core starts without the app window (push, job, alarm); the background job ends when its fetch is done and honours onStopJob; the sync service stops when "Use background connection" is off; tunnels and the WebSocket transport start before mail and are health-checked. The battery prompt appears once, with a dontkillmyapp.com link for the phone's maker. A scheduled send survives an inexact alarm.
- In an **archived chat**, the header menu and in-chat search work again.

### Under the hood

- No core bump: chatmail core 2.65.0 carries over.
